hero: A local repair garage interior: a pickup truck on a lift, a workbench with neatly hung tools, a floor jack; through a high window, rolling Eastern Townships hills in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#10323a), accent highlights (#ff7f66), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems.
